input.patient: The patient presented for care in a non–pregnancy-related encounter, with no evidence of an ongoing pregnancy. There was also no postpartum context; the visit did not represent postpregnancy follow-up in a patient with polycystic ovary syndrome. The patient was not in a preconception phase and was not planning pregnancy; accordingly, preconception counseling for excess weight was not applicable, and the clinical picture did not include a body mass index above 25 kg/m² (BMI was 23.4 kg/m²). Preconception planning was again not present regardless of weight status. The primary clinical focus was management.
